en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large, ornate neo‑classical / neo‑Romanian style building with arched windows and decorative details, set in a sparse garden or park. The top left bears the printed caption in Romanian, and there is printed information along the left edge as well as handwritten cursive text across the bottom and left margins. A postal cancellation mark is faintly visible in the upper right.
